title: Key definitions
rule: The words that decide most cases.
points: Authorised officer: any forest officer, or another officer or person authorised in writing by the Minister or Director.
Forest produce: anything produced by or growing in a forest, including trees, timber, poles, charcoal, firewood, bark, gums and honey.
Tree: includes palms, bamboos, shrubs, bushes, seedlings and re-growth of any age.
Reserved tree: only a tree reserved by Gazette order under s. 65.
Permit: only a permit issued under Part VI.
General land: as defined in the Land Act.
Sensitive area: a catchment area, an area of high biodiversity, or a mangrove area.
Plantation: a planted and managed forest of at least five hectares.
Licence and unreserved land are not defined in the Act.
